glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): phonetic 麻 + semantic 幺 (“small, tiny”).
s_page_origin: Variant of 幺. / Simplified from 麽 (麻 →). Officially adopted as the simplified form of 麽 in the Chinese Character Simplification Scheme (漢字簡化方案) in 1956.
senses: [me] A particle placed after the topic of a compound sentence, used to express tactfulness.
[me] A suffix for forming pronouns or adverbs.
[ma] alternative form of 嗎 (“final interrogative particle”)
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 麼; s_page_origin explains the simplified 么.
